# Cristiano Ronaldo Is the Highest-Paid Athlete in the World: Report  
The Portuguese soccer star tops the ranking for the fourth-straight year.  
[Jeremy Repanich](https://robbreport.com.my/writer/jeremy-repanich/)| June 09, 2026  
[Lionel Messi](https://robbreport.com.my/motors/marine/the-10-best-celeb-owned-superyachts-from-steven-spielbergs-seven-seas-to-max-verstappens-unleash-the-lion/) may have more Ballon d’Or victories than[Cristiano Ronaldo](https://robbreport.com.MY/tag/cristiano-ronaldo/)as world player of the year, but the Portuguese star remains the champion at the bank.  
For the fourth consecutive year—and the sixth time out of the last 11—[Cristiano Ronaldo](https://robbreport.com.my/style/louis-vuitton-cristiano-ronaldo-instagram-record-followers/) has topped*Forbes’s*annual list of the world’s highest-paid athletes. And his US$300 million haul over the last 12 months is bigger than ever before. Of course, a huge chunk of those earnings comes from playing in the Saudi league for Al-Nassr, which paid the 41-year-old star US$235 million last season, while he earned an additional US$65 million off the pitch as a pitchman for numerous brands including Binance, Nike, and Perplexity. Additionally, he’s an investor in a tech subsidiary of Herbalife, which he ploughed US$7.5 million into last year. He also has a pretty impressive [property portfolio](https://robbreport.com.my/shelter/real-estate/cristiano-ronaldo-property-portfolio/), too.
While Ronaldo is one of the oldest athletes on this list, he’s still going strong and will likely top it again in 2027 for a fifth consecutive year. But we’re pretty sure he traded a lot of this wealth to hoist the World Cup trophy this summer.

08. Karim Benzema, Soccer, France: US$104 million
09. Kevin Durant, Basketball, U.S.A.: US$103.8 million
10. Lewis Hamilton, Formula 1, U.K.: US$100 million

# Conheça os 10 atletas mais bem pagos do mundo em 2026  
## Juntos, eles acumularam US$ 1,4 bilhão neste ano; jogador Cristiano Ronaldo lidera a lista  
[Thâmara Kaoru](https://epocanegocios.globo.com/autores/thamara-kaoru/)  
Atualizado  
Pelo quarto ano consecutivo — e pela sexta vez no total — o jogador Cristiano Ronaldo lidera a lista dos atletas mais bem pagos do mundo da [revista Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/brettknight/2026/05/22/the-worlds-10-highest-paid-athletes-2026/), acumulando uma estimativa de US$ 300 milhões nos últimos 12 meses.  
Segundo a publicação, o total inclui cerca de US$ 235 milhões de seu contrato com o clube Al-Nassr e outros US$ 65 milhões vindos de patrocínios, aparições, licenciamento e outros negócios. Ronaldo agora se iguala a Michael Jordan com seis lideranças no ranking da Forbes e fica atrás apenas de Tiger Woods, que alcançou o topo da lista 11 vezes.  
Em relação a 2025, quando já havia estabelecido um recorde para jogadores de futebol, Ronaldo aumentou seus ganhos em US$ 25 milhões. Seus US$ 300 milhões, aliás, empatam com o valor alcançado pelo boxeador Floyd Mayweather Jr. em 2015 como a maior soma já registrada pela Forbes desde o início do ranking, em 1990 (corrigido pela inflação, Mayweather ainda lidera, com o equivalente a US$ 427 milhões).
Somando nomes globais como o boxeador Canelo Álvarez (US$ 170 milhões), o atacante do Inter Miami CF Lionel Messi (US$ 140 milhões), o astro do Los Angeles Lakers LeBron James (US$ 137,8 milhões) e o piloto da Fórmula 1 Lewis Hamilton (US$ 100 milhões), os dez atletas mais bem pagos do mundo acumularam juntos US$ 1,4 bilhão neste ano.  
O valor representa um leve aumento em relação a 2025 e é mais que o dobro dos US$ 635 milhões registrados em 2016, quando Ronaldo liderou a lista pela primeira vez com US$ 88 milhões. Pelo terceiro ano consecutivo, todos os integrantes do top 10 superaram a marca de US$ 100 milhões.  
Juntos, os dez atletas arrecadaram US$ 902 milhões exercendo seus esportes, com salários, bônus e premiações — queda de 2% em relação aos US$ 920 milhões de 2025 e de 8% em comparação ao recorde de US$ 978 milhões de 2024. Mas compensaram isso fora das competições, somando cerca de US$ 513 milhões em patrocínios e negócios próprios, superando o recorde anterior de US$ 512 milhões estabelecido em 2021.
## Confira quem são os 10 atletas mais bem pagos do mundo em 2026

# [Ricky Ponting Highest-Paid Athlete in the World](#)  
- By Carol Kearney
- Canberra
- Last updated on
### Hot news  
- Hot August 2, 2026
- Love August 3, 2026
- Rumor Central August 2026  
It's been a rough year for the athlete, but at least he has his millions of dollars to ease the pain. 51-year-old [Ricky Ponting](https://en.mediamass.net/people/ricky-ponting) has taken the No. 1 spot on *People With Money*’s top 10 highest-paid athletes for 2026 with an estimated $96 million in combined earnings.  
UPDATE 03/08/2026 : This story seems to be false. [(read more)](http://en.mediamass.net/blog/mediamass-project)  
Ricky Ponting tops annual list of highest-paid athletes  
In 2024 it looked like the athlete’s spectacular career was winding down. Suddenly, he was back on top. *People With Money* reports on Sunday (August 2) that Ponting is the highest-paid athlete in the world, pulling in an astonishing $96 million between July 2025 and July 2026, a nearly $60 million lead over his closest competition.  
People With Money’s factors  
In compiling this yearly list, the magazine considers factors such as upfront pay, profit participation, residuals, endorsements and advertising work.
The Australian athlete has an estimated net worth of $275 million. He owes his fortune to smart stock investments, substantial property holdings, lucrative endorsement deals with CoverGirl cosmetics. He also owns several restaurants (the “*Fat Ponting Burger*” chain) in Canberra, a Football Team (the “Launceston Angels”), has launched his own brand of Vodka (*Pure Wonderponting - Australia*), and is tackling the juniors market with a top-selling perfume (*With Love from Ricky*) and a fashion line called “*Ricky Ponting Seduction*”.  
The ranking is significant for many Ricky fans, who have been waiting for his triumphant return to the glory days for what seems like a lifetime.

Lionel Messi may have more Ballon d’Or victories than [Cristiano Ronaldo](https://robbreport.com/tag/cristiano-ronaldo/) as world player of the year, but the Portuguese star remains the champion at the bank.  
For the fourth consecutive year—and the sixth time out of the last 11—Cristiano Ronaldo has topped *Forbes’s* annual list of the world’s highest-paid athletes. And his $300 million haul the last 12 months is bigger than ever before. Of course, a huge chunk of those earnings come from playing in the Saudi league for Al-Nassr, which paid the 41-year-old star $235 million last season, while he earned an additional $65 million off the pitch as pitchman for numerous brands including Binance, Nike, and Perplexity. Additionally, he’s an investor in a tech subsidiary of Herbalife, which he plowed $7.5 million into last year. He also has a pretty impressive [property portfolio](https://robbreport.com/shelter/celebrity-homes/lists/cristiano-ronaldo-property-portfolio-1236973685/), too.  
The athlete who rose to second place in the rankings was also Saudi-aligned. Boxer Canelo Alvarez inked a deal to fight in Saudi Arabia in Riyadh and then fought again in Las Vegas later in the year, drawing the largest crowd to a match in Sin City history. His earnings from inside the squared-circle totaled $160 million, while his business ventures and endorsement deals grossed the 35-year-old fighter $10 million outside of the ring.
Rounding out the top three is Ronaldo’s longtime rival [Lionel Messi](https://robbreport.com/shelter/celebrity-homes/lists/lionel-messi-property-portfolio-1236908836/), who brought home $140 million the past year, splitting those earnings evenly between on-the-pitch and off-field activities. The 38-year-old living legend plies his trade for Miami FC and hopes to lead Argentina to a repeat as World Cup champion in 2026.  
The first American athlete on *Forbes’s* list comes in at No. 4, with [LeBron James](https://robbreport.com/lifestyle/news/lebron-james-nike-lebron-21s-1234874940/) making $137.8 million, with a majority of that coming from off-court earnings. Below him is a fellow L.A. athlete, the Dodgers’s Shohei Ohtani, followed by Golden State Warrior Stephen Curry, Spanish golfer Jon Rahm, French [soccer](https://robbreport.com/tag/soccer/) star Karim Benzema, Houston Rocket Kevin Durant, and F1 legend [Lewis Hamilton](https://robbreport.com/motors/cars/lewis-hamilton-reportedly-leaving-mercedes-for-ferrari-1235495413/) rounding out the top 10.  
While Ronaldo is one of the oldest athletes on this list, he’s still going strong and will likely top it again in 2027 for a fifth consecutive year. But we’re pretty sure he trade a lot of this wealth to hoist the World Cup trophy this summer.
## The 10 Highest Paid Athlete in the World 2026  
01. Cristiano Ronaldo, Soccer, Portugal : $300 million
02. Canelo Alvarez, Boxing, Mexico: $170 million
03. Lionel Messi, Soccer, Argentina: $140 million

06. Stephen Curry, Basketball, U.S.A.: $124.7 million
07. Jon Rahm, Golf, Spain: $107 million
08. Karim Benzema, Soccer, France: $104 million
09. Kevin Durant, Baskeball, U.S.A.: $103.8 million
